metadata.analysis_name: Phase 3C.4E.11 Feature Coverage & Data Quality Analysis

qualifying_delta_to_pole_pct.description: Qualifying knockout session lap time delta to pole position
qualifying_delta_to_pole_pct.notes: 18 unrepresented drivers: 12 did not participate in session, 6 crashed on out-lap or failed scrutineering.

fp2_long_run_median_pace.description: Free Practice 2 median lap time across >= 5 consecutive laps
fp2_long_run_median_pace.notes: 100% structurally unavailable on 2024 sprint weekends (FP2 abolished). 85.1% valid on standard dry weekends.

fp2_long_run_pace_delta_to_field.description: Driver FP2 long-run pace minus field median long-run pace
fp2_long_run_pace_delta_to_field.notes: Mirror of fp2_long_run_median_pace. Requires minimum 5 starters with clean stints to compute field median.

fp2_stint_consistency.description: Standard deviation of clean consecutive timed laps in FP2
fp2_stint_consistency.notes: Requires at least 2 laps to compute std_dev; >= 5 laps required for representative stint.

fp2_tyre_degradation_estimate.description: Linear regression slope of stint lap vs lap time in FP2
fp2_tyre_degradation_estimate.notes: Low reliable yield (< 50%) due to uncalibrated fuel loads, traffic, and track rubbering-in.

sector_pace_delta.description: Sum of driver micro-sector deltas to session best sectors
sector_pace_delta.notes: Highly complete (96.0%). Missing only on micro-sector timing feed dropouts and session non-participants.

sprint_race_pace_indicator.description: Saturday 100km sprint race median pace delta to sprint winner
sprint_race_pace_indicator.notes: Structurally unavailable on 80% of calendar. On sprint weekends, it achieves 98.9% valid measurement.

track_overtaking_difficulty.notes: 100% numerically populated, but 100% classified as SOURCE_NOT_VERIFIED due to heuristic assignment.

fp2_regulations_check_2024.fia_regulation_reference: 2024 FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations, Article 39
fp2_regulations_check_2024.rule: For Sprint Weekends, P1 is held Friday afternoon, Sprint Shootout Friday evening, Sprint Race Saturday morning, Qualifying Saturday afternoon.
fp2_regulations_check_2024.empirical_check: FP2 scheduled count for 2024 Sprint rounds (China, Miami, Austria, Austin, Brazil, Qatar): EXACTLY 0.

TIER_3_HIGH_NOISE_OR_HEURISTIC_EXCLUDED.issue: High noise, fuel variance, low R^2
